item.title: There is a dangerous but natural proclivity to take discourse as it comes rather than critically engaging in why it came about t...
item.description:
There is a dangerous but natural proclivity to take discourse as it comes rather than critically engaging in why it came about that way and who benefits from discussing it - so well before answering the question at hand that is presented to you, and certainly insisting upon others doing the the same, the central question should be why anyone is asking? And of course there can be good in bad reasons individually and collectively to be considering an issue, but those should be obvious and presented well before any discourse is engaged in
